An overconfident [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] '''gambler''' attended an invitation-only [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] [[Zarro Flynn's sabacc tournament|tournament]] on<ref name="Mission" /> the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] organized by the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Zarro Flynn]]<ref name="Mission" /> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Into the Sabacc Pit" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the ongoing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to attend Flynn's tournament despite it being invite-only. While at the tournament, the Zeltron [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] put up some rare possessions of theirs as collateral on a loan but lost, which was beneficial for the individual's companion, who was there to search for [[Black market/Legends|black market]] opportunities.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The gambler was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Into the Sabacc Pit" in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
